features.geometry: all M/L/H/V/C/S/Q/T/A/Z absolute/relative, line/polyline/polygon/circle/ellipse/rect including elliptical rounded corners, primitive/custom geometry and all source/path provenance
features.decoder: full XML/CSS/reference flow, nested svg/symbol/use transform instances, switch BCP47 conditionals, inherited style/viewport/transform/group/text stacks, definitions/metadata/ignored reporting
features.paint: solid, local linear/radial href/default/stop CSS/currentColor/spread/interpolation, bbox/user/inverse handling; image/pattern fill and stroke, independent fill rules and painter/paint order
features.clip: child union, parent intersection, bbox/user units, inherited clip-rule, nested viewport rectangle, conservative boundary mapping and animated owners
features.effects: alpha/luminance nested masks and default/custom regions/content units; nested patterns bbox/user/viewBox/transform/tile repeat/stroke; marker start/mid/end/shorthand/orient/ref/units/viewBox/definition inheritance; groups opacity/blend/isolation; all eight filter primitives/result chains/regions/color spaces
features.media: actual CoreText outlines/bidi/fallback/kerning/ligatures, text/tspan positioning/entities/whitespace/anchor/spacing; SVG exact PNG/JPEG data URI; native PNG/JPEG/static GIF/WebP when ImageIO available; premultiplied bilinear image sampling; full looping GIF export tracked downstream
features.unsupported: preserve original exact reports: external resources/scripts/SVG image URI/textPath/color-only glyph/animated image; original CSS/XML/reference unsupported rules; clipPath transform/style/clip-path forbidden; pattern attribute whitelist without href extension; no new acceptance of formerly unsupported input
features.animation: accepted complete SMIL parse/eval and full legacy render_at composition. Preserve explicit unsupported animated geometry in filter/mask groups or pattern paints and active D/path composition. Do not substitute static frame. Broader authoring/native animation workflows remain product follow-up, not acceptance here.

capacity_contract: check every size/range arithmetic before access or reservation
charge capacity*sizeof(T), source lease capacity once, tokens/open names/cache metadata/reference tables/media/patterns/clips/overlays and concurrent scratch
try_reserve before mutation, release over-cap reservation on failure; no hostile-input panic/assert or fake output
retain original per-scene vs job aggregate counters and nested sync_work propagation; no independent fresh nested budget
caller-selected job memory cap explicit; compatibility defaults retain original finite table/instance ceilings; do not shrink to16MiB/262144-edge renderer
grid/fill ineligibility uses original scalar fallback; resource errors abort normally
work charged before bounded units and not refunded on rollback; per-job counters replace thread-local globals; cancellation at most256units apart outside synchronous native call
math: f64 right-first affine; exact C arithmetic/evaluation sequence, comparisons/sort ties, integer alpha numerators, lround/floor(+0.5), sRGB/linear conversions, blur pass/kernel order and group child->filter->mask->opacity/blend. No reassociation/FMA/SIMD/GPU or source normalization. Keep original premultiplied media sampling conversion and final C Tile encoding.
errors: invalid/NaN/Inf/singular matrices/invalid strides/ranges checked before slice. Original XML/path/value offsets/error precedence. Media Limit->Limit, OOM->OutOfMemory, other failures->Unsupported at href/run offset. Rust Canceled distinct; C adapter limit+flag. Failure drops entire unpublished job, retains source/static scene/generation.
product_gates: 100MB edit/render/save; first content<2s, owner-thread pauses<100ms, pan/zoom p95<33ms and original memory/corpus targets remain. Module caps do not prove product budgets. Progressive tiled work via spatial/tile/task interfaces and controlled resumable APIs required; full UI/E2E/fidelity/corpus/fuzz/performance/release/live demos later.
